title: Antipodea Trainer Registry
description: The Antipodea phone for the Pokémon Westmarch: Messages, Contacts, PokéGram, PokéTube, TikTogepi, Camera, Gallery, Calendar, Trainer Card and Riding Licence, plus an App Store with paid Rotom Phone apps (Translator, Weather, Pro Camera, PokéMaps, PokéPay, Mart Express). Tracks licences and demerits on the Seasons & Stars clock and posts to Discord.

recommends.reason: Shows in-game dates on cards and fines. The module still works off core world time without it.
